PockPock Agent 0.2.11 fixes the Maintenance Manager's **Save choice** button, which saved your choice but gave no sign that it had.

## Download

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) | [PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe) |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer) | [PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| Mac with an Intel processor | [PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg) |

**Already using 0.2.10 on Windows?** PockPock updates itself: press **Restart to update** when it appears, or check in **Settings → Updates**. Your chats, settings, models and caches are kept. On a Mac, download and install it once, the same way as the first time.

**New to PockPock?** Open the downloaded file, then press **Set up PockPock**; setup installs everything else. Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"** because PockPock is not code-signed yet: press **More info**, then **Run anyway**. On a Mac, see the [installation guide](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki/Installation).

## What's new since 0.2.10

### Save choice shows that it worked

- Choosing a different AI for the Maintenance Manager and pressing **Save choice** did save it, but nothing on screen changed, so it looked as if the button did nothing.
- Now the button shows that it is saving, then becomes **Saved** with a check mark, and a line next to it says which AI fixes your reports, for example "Saved. Claude Code fixes your reports from now on."
- If you pick something else, the button says **Save choice** again. If saving fails, the reason is shown next to the button.

## Good to know

- The pull request passed the full check suite (backend tests and desktop typecheck and build on Ubuntu, Windows and macOS), and the fix was checked in the app.
- Everything new in 0.2.10 is described in the [0.2.10 release notes](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/tag/v0.2.10).
